text: Acceptance 6: a zero counter resets clone detection for credentials that previously counted. Reused test/core/webauthn.test.ts's synthetic authenticator in memory: register, then assertLogin with counts 5,0,1 => all returned actorId=1; stored sign_count became 1. Reject a non-increasing count whenever either stored or received count is nonzero; exempt only the always-zero case, and test 5->0.
